title: What if ZX Spectrum’s Deathchase met arcade OutRun in 3D? Here's my solo dev progress on Neon Chase [Trailer]
author: WantedRogue
selftext:
It started off as a bit of fun when I used Claude to recreate, the old ZX Spectrum game, Cruising on Broadway for my sister’s birthday. 

That then led me to want to create my fav game of the same time, also on the Speccy, Deathchase. I then mashed it with my other favourite game of the time, the arcade classic Outrun. In particular the pyramid routing part of the gameplay. 

Without help from Claude, Elevenlabs and Suno, there’s no way I could create this. It’s not like I’ve built a team of agents to make it, I’m using AI to fill the gaps where I don’t have the skills - does that make it AI slop? I create the graphics and assets myself using Blender. The design, gameplay details and specifics are all my ideas just coded by Claude. 

It’s far from finished and I thoroughly enjoy playing it, but I don’t know if that because I’m proud of what I’ve done or if it’s because it’s actually any good.

I’ve even gone as far as creating a gameplay trailer using Capcut - manually not using AI. I feel like I’m going through the motions, but don’t really know what I’m doing. 😂

https://youtu.be/-v1baslx9OA?is=myDLnhyiGv-xK4Sa

comments.author: Suspicious_Neck_4069
comments.body: As a player (and a game developer myself), I don't really care if AI was used or how; what matters to me is the final result, and I think your game is great! Well done! It’s certainly not sloppy work (though personally, I would rework the motorcycle counter).

replies.author: WantedRogue
replies.body:
I always want input. Thank you. What do you mean about the motorcycle counter? I’m not overly happy with the bike, but not sure why. The movement is to jerky, too much tied to the joystick movement and it lack character. It may be need more suspension movement or vibration. 

I agree with you on the AI front, but there seems to be a certain degree of stigma where it’s involved. I guess these things always happen with new technology, people will come round to it and get better at using it constructively.

comments.author: digitalBardo
comments.body: this is really cool, far from slop. The visuals give me Tron vibes. The music matches the visuals really well. It seems to be fast and furious and good for a quick game. I loved Deathchase on the Spectrum so this is exciting. Good job!!

replies.author: WantedRogue
replies.body: Thank you. I really appreciate positive feedback. Deathchase was such a heat game back in the day.

comments.author: ZymzAlchemy
comments.body: This will be amazing on a handheld, can't wait to play it.
